task.title: Validate a docs project
task.shortdesc: Run the same checks as CI and the hosted build: broken links, missing chunks, undeclared values, bad release ranges and more.

context.p: opend validate builds the project in memory and reports every problem with its file, line and column. The previewer and the hosted worker run exactly the same checks, so a project that validates locally publishes.

step.cmd: From the OpenD checkout, validate your docs folder.

stepresult.p: Each problem prints on its own line, followed by a summary:
stepresult.codeblock: topics/install.dita:14:9: error [broken-link] link target not found: setup.dita topics/install.dita:20:7: warning [unresolved-key] key "edition" is not defined; using fallback content 1 error(s), 1 warning(s)

info.p: The code in brackets identifies the problem. explains every code and how to fix it.

step.cmd: Optional: validate a release branch or tag without checking it out.

result.p: The command exits with status 1 when there is at least one error, and 0 otherwise. Warnings do not fail it unless you pass --strict.
